description:
## Goal

Make the one retained InputFlowRelation preserve each direct-call argument frame atomically, including normalized local denotations and exact origin-path operands. A consumer substitutes one real frame, never Cartesianizes independent input columns, recovers information omitted at publication, or mistakes a complete nullary value for semantic absence.

## Proven defects

DirectCallFlow stores independent input columns. Coherent frames {(a,b),(c,d)} and crossed frames {(a,d),(c,b)} collapse to the same fact. Local constants disappear, so same(x, :hit) and same(x, :miss) retain equal relations.

The first correlated-frame implementation separately interpreted every LoweredStep variant and omitted lambda captures, dynamic bitstring sizes, and BitstringRead outputs. jobs/body.rs, jobs/artifact.rs, and executable_facts.rs also independently enumerated generic definitions or reads.

Cold review exposed four additional laws:

- A fully overwritten map-update base is a no-contribution product unit, not an impossible alternative; deleting it must not annihilate a surviving replacement or branch choice.
- Definition/read/capture-only consumers must not pay for semantic aggregate classification or repeated map suffix scans.
- Already normalized exclusion sets must be copied into the retained selector without sorting or deduplicating again.
- No transfer records cannot mean both an impossible alternative sum and an empty simultaneous product. Empty tuple/list/map/struct/bitstring constructors and function references are complete local values, not no-contribution units. An impossible delivered branch must remain impossible.

## Correct-by-construction model

LoweredStep owns one exhaustive typed value-definition authority. Every variant and field is destructured without catch-all field patterns. It describes definitions, raw reads, semantic contributions, control-local AssertSame equalities, callable captures, and complete local construction results. A consumer selects only the work it needs before any aggregate loop. No consumer keeps another LoweredStep opcode inventory.

The value algebra separates three levels explicitly:

- an empty alternative set is the additive zero: impossible;
- one alternative with no contribution terms is the multiplicative unit and retains branch choices;
- every complete local value has an explicit term: an exact normalized denotation when representable, otherwise a typed opaque value with its complete flattened exact operand set, including zero operands.\n\nThe typed local denotation preserves observable construction identity at every arity: tuple/list shape, map kind, struct ModuleId, normalized empty bitstring, and callable FunctionId/kind. These are typed semantic values, never rendered names or opcode tags; structural children remain ordinary path contributions.

A definition slot distinguishes absent definition, simultaneous Contributions, and explicit Alternatives. Definitions never mix both meanings in one transfer vector. Alternatives(empty) is defined impossibility; Contributions(empty) resolves to the product unit. Delivered resumes begin as Alternatives(empty) and union only real resolved deliveries. Projection or embedding may filter every contribution term while preserving the surviving product unit and choices. Only incompatible choices eliminate an alternative. Missing definitions alone become explicit unknown local values. Delivered impossibility never becomes an empty product.

One DirectCallFlow owns a canonical set of complete positional call-input frames. Each frame is one real correlated alternative across every callee input; zero arguments is one empty frame. A slot retains exact typed origin or normalized local-denotation atoms, or one flat opaque term naming every exact operand it may read. Control-flow choice markers exist only during extraction and are stripped after compatible frames form. No display text, source spelling, span, ValueId, ControlEntryId, Ty allocation order, rendered type, or ad-hoc opcode string is semantic identity.

Source projection and result embedding reuse InputPathStep and compose_paths. Dynamic map selectors, exclusions, remainders, list, tuple, and bitstring paths do not gain a second walker. Map reads are one forward pass. Map semantic contributions are one right-to-left pass with one ordered set of normalized later-known LiteralDenotationRef values. That pass alone owns last-writer, dynamic-exclusion, and remainder meaning. The retained selector accepts this sorted unique set directly.

Callable-capture endpoints are retained during the necessary semantic pass, or obtained through capture-only work that enters no unrelated aggregate loop. Extraction never reruns semantic classification merely to discard every non-capture role.

The existing World InputFlow fact remains the sole authority. Equal normalized frame sets retain allocation and generation and wake nobody. Source replacement withdraws obsolete frames exactly.

## TDD

1. RED from the clean predecessor: literal and coherent-versus-crossed relations collapse. After cutover both distinctions remain exact.
2. Capturing lambdas, constructed bitstrings, every BitstringRead output, and opaque local computations retain exact origins and literals.
3. Multi-output definitions survive retained-value and artifact boundaries. Overwritten map values remain evaluation reads but are not semantic contributions.
4. A fully overwritten %{a:x} base contributes no terms while replacement y survives. Correlated full and partial branch overwrites retain exactly real frames and choices.
5. Algebra tests distinguish impossible sum, empty contribution product, explicit opaque unknown, and complete local values. Empty tuple/list/map and constructed empty bitstring have their correct distinct normalized denotations; struct modules and callable target/kind survive at every arity; capture-free closure and function-reference kinds remain distinct; impossible delivery cannot become a unit; missing definitions alone use unknown fallback.
6. Deterministic work counts prove: Definitions on an n-entry map visits/classifies 0 entries; Reads visits n and classifies 0; Semantics classifies n once with n normalized-key operations and exact emitted exclusions. Production extraction performs no second semantic pass for capture discovery.
7. The input-flow consumer copies already normalized exclusions without sort/dedup or selector reinterpretation.
8. Two calls never cross-connect. Independent merges produce exactly real joint alternatives. Zero arguments produces one empty frame.
9. Branch, source, and job-order permutations reproduce byte-equal content. Equal publication retains allocation and revision and schedules no reader. Replacement retracts only obsolete frames.
10. The composition fixture drives dynamic bit size through constructed bits, a captured closure, and a direct call, asserting distinct size outcomes on interp, run, and build.

Every semantic defect witness must fail through the production boundary on the relevant predecessor before the model changes.

## Deletion and boundaries

Delete DirectCallFlow independent columns, the input_flow opcode match, duplicate generic result/read enumerators, map-specific literal identity, overloaded empty-transfer representation, eager universal-role work, duplicate capture scan, suffix scans, consumer normalization of normalized exclusions, and helpers or tests that treat local constants or complete nullary values as absence. Leave no frame side table, compatibility columns, second fact, display classifier, consumer opcode inventory, timing threshold, proof-only probe, or migration debris.

Do not mechanically replace policy-specific semantic typing, codegen, or callable-escape analysis with generic reads. runtime_demand callable escape behavior requires its own production witness before convergence. Replacing ExprStep or introducing a macro-generated instruction schema is outside this ticket.

This ticket corrects the retained relation boundary landed by fz-kdt.214 and blocks fz-kdt.200. fz-kdt.200 owns the finite joint QuestionTemplate carrier, relational question canonicalization/substitution, recursive solver, and activation cutover. fz-kdt.188 separately removes fabricated Cartesian ActivationInputRow after semantic coalescing. Closed fz-kdt.81 and fz-1ah.8 cover different retained authorities.

## Acceptance

All falsifying witnesses remain distinct at the retained production boundary. One typed LoweredStep authority publishes complete value meaning; alternative sums, contribution products, and complete values have distinct identities. Generic consumers are selective, capture discovery causes no duplicate semantic traversal, and normalized exclusions are not normalized twice. Direct duplicate enumerators and repeated suffix scans are gone. The relation remains immutable, deterministic, replacement-aware, and allocation-retaining on equal reproduction.

Focused role, extraction, path, and frame tests; serial library; serial fixture matrix; all three target doors; cross-process determinism; documentation checks; cargo check; strict clippy; formatting; and diff checks pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the final frozen diff before its one commit and close.
title: Preserve correlated semantic call frames in InputFlowRelation
